methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company that reaches customers, viewers and guests worldwide through the connectivity and platforms services we provide and the content and experiences we create' (FY2025 10-K); 'As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming services in lieu of linear video services, which continue to experience accelerated net customer losses, our video customers and video revenues, and linear television network subscriber fees received from video service providers, each decrease'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast

theme_watch.reason: Live: Comcast's own FY2025 10-K says 'Changes in consumer behavior continue to adversely affect our businesses and challenge existing business models. As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming services in lieu of linear video services, which continue to experience accelerated net customer losses, our video customers and video revenues, and linear television network subscriber fees received from video service providers, each decrease.' At the same time it delivers its own content directly to consumers: 'The continuing trend of content owners, including us with Peacock, delivering their content directly to consumers, rather than through, or in addition to, traditional video distribution channels also disrupts traditional media distribution business models.'. The stock trades at 4.4x FY26E — a discount to its own history. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of streaming to 2015-08-04 (Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off), evidence that names Disney's networks, not Comcast. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (STREAMING) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing streaming substitution of Comcast's video customers or networks specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company that reaches customers, viewers and guests worldwide through the connectivity and platforms services we provide and the content and experiences we create' (FY2025 10-K); 'As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming services in lieu of linear video services, which continue to experience accelerated net customer losses, our video customers and video revenues, and linear television network subscriber fees received from video service providers, each decrease'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.03x; -63% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.58; conservative 2yr +226%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.4%/yr (worst year FY16-FY25 ex-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +1.9%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.4%/yr (FY16-FY25 ex-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +21.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25 ex-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2026-07-31) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.03x (12.4% downside to Bear $21 / +430.1% upside to Bull $127) | Adj composite 1.80 vs market 1.22: gap +0.58 [UNDERVALUED] | -63% above the EPP floor $65 (12x FY26E $5.39) | Conservative 2-yr case: +226.3% total (+113.1%/yr) | At 4.4x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $32 sits at or below the BASE case; video subscribers -9.4% in Q2 2026, forward revenues -1.2% (no FY26 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2026 revenue growth); streaming is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
